newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe calls for EU role in Albanian elections.
newsitem.headline: Juppe calls for EU role in Albanian elections.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe called on Saturday on the European Union to play a role in organising presidential and general elections in Albania.
"Should we send an expeditionary corps? I think we should first try to play a political role," Juppe told Canal-Plus television.

"Europe must support...a political project for national reconciliation. We should help place what Albanian political forces remain around a negotiating table so that real presidential and general elections are organised and the Albanians can express themselves," he said.
Juppe also said humanitarian action and economic aid were needed.
He spoke as European Union foreign ministers, including France's Herve de Charette, met in the Netherlands to search for a response to the Albanian crisis.
The Europeans were divided on on whether to back calls for military intervention.
